title: Preloader

semantic.purpose: Load-progress cover with the wordmark reveal.

retrievalIneligibleReason: Loading cover shown only until assets are ready; Runtime UI that exists only during interaction or loading; it carries no page content and must never be retrieved as a section to compose.

responsive.desktop: Fixed full-screen cover until WebGL textures are ready, then slides up.
responsive.mobile: Shown once with threeReady=true (no textures to wait for).

measured.note: Transient: removed before measurement settles; full viewport while visible.
